choices.reason: The paper treats text and image quality as parallel primary ad-quality outcomes, without prioritizing either; preregistration priority could not be confirmed because both cited OSF endpoints were inaccessible. Rules 2-3 cannot rank different outcomes, and rules 4-7 do not distinguish these ratings of the same ads from the same arms and session, so no rule resolves the tie.

choices.quote: We begin by examining the primary outcomes of human-AI collaboration: productivity, ad quality, and output diversity.
